background.executionContext:
1. **Setup** — `pwd` (repo root ✅), `./b4w.ps1 help`, `./b4w.ps1 --help-json`, read `skills/browser4-cli/SKILL.md` fully. The captcha plugin is *not* mentioned anywhere in CLI help or SKILL.md; found it by grepping the repo (`browser4-plugins/browser4-captcha`), then read the plugin's `CaptchaToolExecutor`, detectors, and `docs/config.md` §CAPTCHA.
2. **Plugin install** — `./b4w.ps1 status` (backend up, bundle matches checkout), `./b4w.ps1 plugin list` → `No plugins installed.` Discovered `plugin install <jar>` from help; installed the local 4.13.27-SNAPSHOT jar; restarted via `./b4w.ps1 stop` (next command auto-starts the dev backend). `plugin list` then showed the plugin `loaded`.
3. **Invocation problem** — no CLI command reaches plugin tools. `help captcha` → `Unknown command: captcha`; no command in `--help-json` maps to `captcha_detect`. Worked around by POSTing to the same endpoint the CLI uses internally: `http://localhost:18182/mcp/call-tool` with `{"tool":"captcha_detect","arguments":{"sessionId":"<id>"}}` (session id from `./b4w.ps1 list`).
4. **Runs** — for each page: `./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval goto <url>` (3.7–6.7 s), then the `captcha_detect` call, timing with `curl -w %{time_total}`. Results as in the table; all raw responses saved under `.test-sessions/20261004T1433038523034Z/` (`detect-*.json`, `get-balance.json`, `solve-recaptcha.json`, `EVIDENCE.md`).
5. **Root-cause investigation (reCAPTCHA false negative)** — bisected `CaptchaSolveScripts.DETECT_RECAPTCHA` through `eval --file`: the script works up to the `isV3` block, whose regex `/recaptcha\.execute\(.../` contains an escaped `\(`. Proved the mechanism: raw CDP `Runtime.evaluate` returns `1` for `(() => "(".length)()`, while `browser_evaluate`/`eval` returns `null`; replacing `\(` with `\x28` (removing the raw-paren imbalance) makes the full detection script return `present:true` with the correct siteKey. Decompiled `JsUtils.toCDPCompatibleExpression` → `toIIFEOrNull` → `isAlreadyInvokedIIFE` from `pulsar-common-4.11.24.jar` (javap) and confirmed it counts **raw** parens with no string/regex awareness; the mis-wrapped IIFE throws `TypeError: (intermediate value)(...) is not a function`, which the driver silently converts to `null`. Sibling plugins (`browser4-images`, `browser4-media`) document this exact pitfall in code comments and use a named-function pattern instead — the captcha plugin's scripts were not updated.
6. **Timing/negative-control runs** — repeated detects (0.24–0.25 s), `getBalance` (0.02 s), `solve` (0.07 s), and captured the two false-positive challenge warnings produced by the CLI's own navigation probe.

Workarounds required: manual plugin JAR install + restart; direct `/mcp/call-tool` HTTP calls for every plugin tool (no CLI surface); `eval --file` probes to obtain the siteKey the tool failed to return.

**Requested details for step 2 (reCAPTCHA):** the tool reported `isPresent=false`, `captchaType=UNKNOWN`, `siteKey=null`, `confidence=0.0`. The site key actually on the page — extracted independently via the same detection logic once the pipeline bug was bypassed — is **`6Le-wvkSAAAAAPBMRTvw0Q4Muexq9bi0DJwx_mJ-`** (Google's public v2 demo key). Detection returned a wrong answer, silently, with no error.

**Step 6:** `captcha_get_balance` returned **`0.0`** in 0.02–0.07 s, and `captcha_solve` returned `status=FAILED, provider=NONE, error="All 0 solver(s) failed to solve the CAPTCHA"`. **No solving service is configured** (no API keys in `application.properties`), but neither reply says so — `0.0` is indistinguishable from a genuine zero balance.

issues.title: captcha.detect returns isPresent=false on Google's live reCAPTCHA v2 demo (false negative)

sections.body: 1) ./b4w.ps1 plugin install browser4-plugins/browser4-captcha/target/browser4-captcha-4.13.27-SNAPSHOT.jar ; ./b4w.ps1 stop ; 2) ./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval goto "https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/demo" ; 3) curl -s -X POST http://localhost:18182/mcp/call-tool -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tool":"captcha_detect","arguments":{"sessionId":"<sid>"}}'
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: isPresent=true, captchaType=RECAPTCHA_V2, siteKey=6Le-wvkSAAAAAPBMRTvw0Q4Muexq9bi0DJwx_mJ-, confidence>0.9
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: isPresent=false, captchaType=UNKNOWN, siteKey=null, confidence=0.0 — no error, no warning; reproduced 3x on repeated navigation. The page genuinely hosts the widget (anchor iframe src contains k=6Le-wvkSAAAAAPBMRTvw0Q4Muexq9bi0DJwx_mJ-).
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: CaptchaSolveScripts.DETECT_RECAPTCHA contains the regex /recaptcha\.execute\([^,]+,\s*['"](\w+)['"]/ whose escaped '(' makes the raw '(' / ')' counts over the whole script 39/38. Every script goes through JsUtils.toCDPCompatibleExpression -> toIIFEOrNull -> isAlreadyInvokedIIFE (pulsar-common-4.11.24.jar), which counts raw parentheses only (no string/regex/comment awareness). With the count unbalanced it fails to recognize the already-invoked IIFE and wraps it again as ((<expr>))(); — calling the result value as a function. CDP raises TypeError: (intermediate value)(...) is not a function; evaluateValue returns Evaluate.result.value (null) and ignores exceptionDetails, so RecaptchaDetector's 'as? String ?: return NOT_PRESENT' turns an infrastructure failure into a silent 'no CAPTCHA'. hCaptcha/Turnstile scripts are also IIFEs but have balanced raw parens, which is why only reCAPTCHA fails.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body: browser4-plugins/browser4-captcha/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/captcha/CaptchaSolveScripts.kt (DETECT_RECAPTCHA) and detection/RecaptchaDetector.kt:41-47; framework root cause in ai.platon.pulsar.common.js.JsUtils.isAlreadyInvokedIIFE (pulsar-common jar, not in this checkout)
sections.label: Code Pointer

sections.body:
- Rewrite DETECT_RECAPTCHA using the named-function + invocation pattern that browser4-images/ImageDetector.kt:151 and browser4-media/VideoDetector.kt:124 already use to dodge this exact pitfall
- At minimum remove unmatched raw parens from the script (e.g. use \x28 for the literal '(' in the recaptcha.execute regex); verify with ./b4w.ps1 eval --file <script> before shipping
- Make RecaptchaDetector fail loudly (log warn / throw) when the evaluation result is null or not a String, instead of silently returning NOT_PRESENT, so infra failures do not masquerade as 'no CAPTCHA'
- Add an E2E regression test against a reCAPTCHA v2 fixture asserting isPresent=true and the expected siteKey
sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement

issues.title: eval silently returns null for valid JavaScript whose raw parenthesis counts are unbalanced

sections.body: printf '%s' '(() => "(".length)()' > q1.js && ./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval eval --file q1.js  → null. Control: '(() => "ab".length)()' → 2. Raw CDP for the same input: ./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval cdp Runtime.evaluate --json '{"expression":"(() => \"(\".length)()","returnByValue":true}' → {"result":{"value":1}}
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: The expression evaluates to 1 (it is valid JS); any failure is reported as an error with the CDP exceptionDetails text.
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: Returns the literal null with the misleading hint 'Expression returned null. The queried element or property may not exist on this page.' Any expression with a raw '(' not matched by a raw ')' — e.g. a regex escape \(, a lone '(' inside a string, a comment — is mis-wrapped as ((<expr>))(); and silently nulled. This also silently corrupts plugin/vendor scripts (see the reCAPTCHA issue).
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: ai.platon.pulsar.common.js.JsUtils.toCDPCompatibleExpression calls toIIFEOrNull, whose isAlreadyInvokedIIFE walks the raw character stream incrementing/decrementing a depth counter for '(' and ')' without skipping strings, regex literals, or comments. When the counter never returns to 0 the already-invoked IIFE is re-wrapped with StringConcat recipe "(…)(…);". The resulting TypeError is not surfaced: the evaluateValue family returns Evaluate.result.value (null for a thrown error) and ignores Evaluate.exceptionDetails.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body: ai.platon.pulsar.common.js.JsUtils.toCDPCompatibleExpression / isAlreadyInvokedIIFE / toIIFEOrNull (pulsar-common jar — external dependency, upstream fix); in-repo consumers: browser4-plugins/browser4-captcha/.../CaptchaSolveScripts.kt
sections.label: Code Pointer

sections.body:
- Fix isAlreadyInvokedIIFE to be JS-aware: strip/skip string literals, template literals, regex literals and comments before counting, or detect an invoked IIFE with a real JavaScript parser
- Make toIIFEOrNull refuse to re-wrap a string that already parses as a complete expression
- Propagate Evaluate.exceptionDetails as an error (or at least log it) in the evaluateValue/evaluateValueDetail paths instead of returning null
- Add unit tests for: regex containing \(, lone '(' in a string, parens in template literals and comments, and a balanced control
sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement

issues.title: Navigation challenge-probe false positives push users toward unnecessary headed escalation

sections.body: 1) ./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval goto "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CAPTCHA" → warns "detected URL matches the block/challenge marker `/captcha`" on a normal Wikipedia article. 2) ./b4w.ps1 -s captcha-eval goto "https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/demo" → warns "page text is implausibly empty (64 chars) after a successful navigation" although the page (a CAPTCHA widget demo) is fully functional; the widget and iframes are present.
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: No blocked/challenge advisory on these pages; the article URL merely contains the word CAPTCHA, and a page whose visible text is rendered inside an iframe/CAPTCHA widget legitimately has little body text. When the probe does fire, it should not advise a mode switch that costs a session teardown.
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: Both navigations print the anti-bot advisory and the recommendation to close, re-open --headed and retry — a costly, unnecessary action. SKILL.md teaches the escalation as the documented response to this warning, so a rule-following agent will perform it.
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: detect_block_signature (cli/browser4-cli/src/main.rs:23302) matches BLOCKED_URL_SIGNATURES as plain case-insensitive substrings — "/captcha" matches inside /wiki/CAPTCHA — and flags any http(s) page with fewer than IMPLAUSIBLY_EMPTY_BODY_CHARS=80 visible characters as an empty-body challenge, without considering iframe/frame content or DOM size.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body: cli/browser4-cli/src/main.rs — BLOCKED_URL_SIGNATURES (line 23225), match_blocked_url (23278), IMPLAUSIBLY_EMPTY_BODY_CHARS (23261), detect_block_signature (23302)
sections.label: Code Pointer

sections.body:
- Match URL markers against path segments with boundaries (e.g. (^|/)captcha(/|$) or query keys) instead of raw substrings, and/or down-rank markers embedded in content paths such as /wiki/ or /article/
- For the empty-body signal, also require a low DOM-node count or the absence of iframes/frames before warning, so widget-only pages are exempt
- Keep the warning advisory but only suggest --headed when a body/URL challenge marker fired, not for the weak empty-body signal
- Add regression tests: URL /wiki/CAPTCHA must not match; an iframe-only demo page must not match
